text:
maya: Hey team — opened a docs PR to consolidate the Optimize toolkit pages for batching, caching, and quant profiles. Can I get a quick review and a short SDK snippet (py/js) to include? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
sam: Thanks! I'll skim this afternoon. Two quick asks: (1) add a short perf table (tokens/sec baseline vs. with batching+cache) and (2) there's a dead link under Caching -> TTLs (404). Can someone fix?
chris: I can drop in SDK snippets. Which API shape should we show? The hosted API has the new "optimize.run" route, but we also want examples for Dedicated/private using the SDK client.
leo: One runtime note — the KV prefix caching has weird fallbacks on long prefix chains; suggest adding a small caution note under Caching caveats. Also clarify that q4_0 profiles are for latency-focused deploys; q8_* preserves accuracy more.
docs-bot: Staging docs build succeeded for PR #4321 :white_check_mark: (build 2024-09-14T18:23Z)
maya: Good call, leo. Sam — can you paste the broken link? I'll patch it. Chris — yes please include both hosted/sdk forms. Keep snippets <10 lines.
chris: Draft snippets below — feel free to copy. Python:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
resp = client.optimize.run(model='redwood-1', tasks=[{'type':'generate','prompt':'Summarize:'}], batching={'max_batch_time_ms':50}, cache={'prefix_kv':True})
print(resp.outputs[0].text)
```
JS:
```javascript
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })
const r = await c.optimize.run({ model: 'redwood-1', tasks: [{type: 'generate', prompt: 'TL;DR'}], batching: {maxBatchMs: 50}, cache: {prefixKV: true} })
console.log(r.outputs[0].text)
```
sam: Small nit — the SDK call is `optimize.run()` in py, but in JS the option names are camelCase (`maxBatchMs` and `prefixKV`) — also suggest adding a note that `cache.prefixKV` requires runtime >= 1.12+
maya: Perfect. I'll add the perf table (placeholder numbers for now) and update the Caching link. Can someone volunteer to backport this to the v1.9 branch once merged? :hand:
leo: I can backport after merge. Also added a short sentence about quantization tradeoffs.
maya: Amazing, thanks all — assigning sam + chris for final review. Will merge once both approve. :rocket:
